svg.text: word Connected. Battery bars follow the level; bolt for charging; plug for external

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: power without a level; battery_unknown when a battery-reporting radio has no reading; no

svg.text: live. The banner and TalkBack give its age. Failed draws the link glyph in the error
